note: BLM Kemmerer Field Office campground on the west shore of Fontenelle Reservoir, about 30 mi north of Kemmerer off US-189, on a paved route; two loops of sites with sunshade-covered tables and grills on open sage benches, a free concrete boat ramp with docking platform, and a camp host. --Claude

Lakeview confirmed (BLM photo of a site overlooking the lake; imagery). Pin fine. Phone 307-828-4500 confirmed. Stored 'reservable online' was wrong.
